# google_vertex_ai_monitored_agent

Enables anomaly detection monitoring on an agent discovered by Agent Anomaly
Detection (AAD). Agents are auto-discovered when they emit traces via ADK;
this resource controls whether anomaly detection is active on a given agent.
Creating this resource calls EnableMonitoredAgent; destroying it calls
DisableMonitoredAgent.

~> **Note:** The monitored agent must already be discovered by AAD (via the
background sync job) before it can be enabled. If `terraform apply` fails
with NOT_FOUND, wait a few minutes for discovery and retry. An active
AgentAnomalyDetectionScope must also exist in the same region.

~> **Warning:** This resource is in beta, and should be used with the terraform-provider-google-beta provider.
See [Provider Versions](../guides/provider_versions.html.markdown) for more details on beta resources.

To get more information about MonitoredAgent, see:

* [API documentation](https://cloud.google.com/vertex-ai/docs/reference/rest/v1beta1/projects.locations.monitoredAgents)
* How-to Guides
    * [Agent Anomaly Detection](https://cloud.google.com/vertex-ai/generative-ai/docs/agent-engine/)

## Example Usage - Vertex Ai Monitored Agent Basic


```hcl
resource "google_logging_project_bucket_config" "aad-log-bucket" {
  provider       = google-beta
  project        = data.google_project.project.project_id
  location       = "us-central1"
  retention_days = 30
  bucket_id      = "aad-log-bucket"
}

resource "google_vertex_ai_agent_anomaly_detection_scope" "aad-scope" {
  provider                         = google-beta
  region                           = "us-central1"
  agent_anomaly_detection_scope_id = "aad-scope"
  log_buckets = [
    google_logging_project_bucket_config.aad-log-bucket.id,
  ]
  observability_buckets = [
    "projects/${data.google_project.project.project_id}/locations/us-central1/observationBuckets/aad-obs-bucket",
  ]
}

resource "google_vertex_ai_monitored_agent" "agent" {
  provider           = google-beta
  region             = "us-central1"
  monitored_agent_id = "example-agent-id"
  disable_on_destroy = true

  depends_on = [google_vertex_ai_agent_anomaly_detection_scope.aad-scope]
}

data "google_project" "project" {
  provider = google-beta
}
```

## Argument Reference

The following arguments are supported:


* `region` -
  (Required)
  The region of the MonitoredAgent, e.g. us-central1.

* `monitored_agent_id` -
  (Required)
  The ID of the MonitoredAgent, which is the final component of its
  resource name.


* `project` - (Optional) The ID of the project in which the resource belongs.
    If it is not provided, the provider project is used.

* `deletion_policy` - (Optional) Whether Terraform will be prevented from destroying the resource. Defaults to DELETE.
	When a 'terraform destroy' or 'terraform apply' would delete the resource,
	the command will fail if this field is set to "PREVENT" in Terraform state.
	When set to "ABANDON", the command will remove the resource from Terraform
	management without updating or deleting the resource in the API.
	When set to "DELETE", deleting the resource is allowed.
* `disable_on_destroy` - (Optional) If set to true (the default), disabling the monitored agent on destroy.
If set to false, only removes the resource from Terraform state without
calling DisableMonitoredAgent.


## Attributes Reference

In addition to the arguments listed above, the following computed attributes are exported:

* `id` - an identifier for the resource with format `projects/{{project}}/locations/{{region}}/monitoredAgents/{{monitored_agent_id}}`

* `name` -
  The resource name of the MonitoredAgent, in the format
  projects/{{project}}/locations/{{location}}/monitoredAgents/{{monitored_agent}}

* `display_name` -
  The display name of the MonitoredAgent.

* `agent_resource` -
  The configuration for the agent being monitored.
  Structure is [documented below](#nested_agent_resource).

* `state` -
  The current enablement state of the agent.

* `status_message` -
  A brief message explaining the current state.

* `create_time` -
  The time the MonitoredAgent was created.

* `update_time` -
  The time the MonitoredAgent was last updated.


<a name="nested_agent_resource"></a>The `agent_resource` block contains:

* `agent_type` -
  (Output)
  The type of the agent.

* `agent` -
  (Output)
  The full resource name of the agent. For REASONING_ENGINE, format:
  projects/{{project}}/locations/{{location}}/reasoningEngines/{{agent}}

* `location` -
  (Output)
  The Google Cloud location (region) of the agent resource.

## Timeouts

This resource provides the following
[Timeouts](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/plugin/sdkv2/resources/retries-and-customizable-timeouts) configuration options:

- `create` - Default is 3 minutes.
- `delete` - Default is 3 minutes.

## Import


MonitoredAgent can be imported using any of these accepted formats:

* `projects/{{project}}/locations/{{region}}/monitoredAgents/{{monitored_agent_id}}`
* `{{project}}/{{region}}/{{monitored_agent_id}}`
* `{{region}}/{{monitored_agent_id}}`
* `{{monitored_agent_id}}`

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, use an [`identity` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/block/import#identity) to import MonitoredAgent using identity values. For example:

```tf
import {
  identity = {
    region = "<-required value->"
    monitoredAgentId = "<-required value->"
    project = "<-optional value->"
  }
  to = google_vertex_ai_monitored_agent.default
}
```

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, use an [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) to import MonitoredAgent using one of the formats above. For example:

```tf
import {
  id = "projects/{{project}}/locations/{{region}}/monitoredAgents/{{monitored_agent_id}}"
  to = google_vertex_ai_monitored_agent.default
}
```

When using the [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import), MonitoredAgent can be imported using one of the formats above. For example:

```
$ terraform import google_vertex_ai_monitored_agent.default projects/{{project}}/locations/{{region}}/monitoredAgents/{{monitored_agent_id}}
$ terraform import google_vertex_ai_monitored_agent.default {{project}}/{{region}}/{{monitored_agent_id}}
$ terraform import google_vertex_ai_monitored_agent.default {{region}}/{{monitored_agent_id}}
$ terraform import google_vertex_ai_monitored_agent.default {{monitored_agent_id}}
```
